desc: You hear a strange recording about the "apocalypse" at the lake to the west of Piramida...

customize.name: The Tale-Telling Heart
customize.desc: A group of people, each with their own story to tell, lights a bonfire at Blue Amber Lake...

customize.name: Whisper Beneath the Waves
customize.desc: You discover a strange tree at the Eye of Kratti...

customize.desc: You hear a strange recording about the "apocalypse" at the lake to the west of Piramida...

customize.name: Adventure EXP
customize.desc: Adventure EXP. Used to improve Adventure Rank.

customize.name: Primogem
customize.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Hero's Wit
customize.desc:
Character EXP material. Gives 20000 EXP.
These experiences are extremely precious for a pilgrim traveling through Teyvat in order to be closer to Celestia.

customize.name: Mystic Enhancement Ore
customize.desc:
Weapon EXP material. Gives 10,000 EXP.
Legend has it that this refined ingot contains the memories of battles that had taken place in the land. The weapons that benefit from these memories naturally become sentient.

customize.name: Reed Miller
customize.desc: Avrelian was the ideal heir who was supposed to lead the Frosmoon Scions to the Elysium. He was the Great Thief, Reed Miller, and the founder of the Treasure Hoarders. Avrelian lived 500 years ago.

customize.name: Tier I Bunker Access Card
customize.desc:
A key card obtained from a peculiar terminal on the west side of Piramida. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.
From what you've been told, it should grant access to the bunker beneath the terminal.

customize.name: Spare Bunker Handwheel
customize.desc: A spare handwheel used for maintaining the Doomsday Purification System. It shows no signs of rust, yet for some reason it still carries a faint, lingering scent of iron.

customize.name: Tier II Bunker Access Card
customize.desc:
A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.
Neat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Senior Maintenance Technician Aleksey Zakharevich Kotelnikov."

customize.name: Tier III Bunker Access Card
customize.desc:
A key card obtained from an experiment site. Its appearance is utterly unremarkable.
Neat Snezhnayan text has been printed onto its surface: "Chief Researcher Grazina Myklukho."

customize.name: Devocina-Cognoscenti's Sorrow
customize.desc: A timepiece long since stopped. It is said to be a keepsake from Reed Miller, the founder of the Treasure Hoarders.

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Wavechaser Plain, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> "...Welcome... the apocalypse..."
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> "...Welcome to... bunker... the apocalypse..."
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> "...Welcome to the bunker at the end of the apocalypse. Collect your ID card from the auto-distribution terminal. Please enter in an orderly manner..."
<color=#ffffff>Gentle Female Voice:</color> "...Welcome to Bunker No. (...), friends from afar..."
<color=#ffffff>Gentle Female Voice:</color> "...If you are listening to this recording, it means that the apocalypse is imminent..."
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa! Paimon almost died of fright. She didn't realize this thing could talk! Whoa, whoa, whoa, Paimon's missing something — did it just say something super scary that went right over Paimon's head?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I think she mentioned the apocalypse...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Nothing scary, just that the apocalypse is coming.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, it's just the apocalypse — that's a big weight off Paimon's chest...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> ...Except obviously it's not!!! How can you be so casual about it? That tone — you sound like you're announcing we're having Chicken-Mushroom Skewers for breakfast!
<color=#ffffff>Gentle Female Voice:</color> "...Fortunately, you have found this bunker, and we are grateful to have you here... together... in the bunker at the end of the apocalypse..."
<color=#ffffff>Gentle Female Voice:</color> "...Please... use the key card... The lift connects... safe... take... to the bunker..."
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa, did the mechanism just break? All that fuzzy noise drowned out her voice. Paimon couldn't hear what she was saying...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon can't figure out what this place is... Traveler, why don't we go inside and take a look?
Quest Objective: Enter the bunker
Quest Objective: Continue onward
Quest Objective: Investigate the nearby area
<color=#ffffff>"Access approved. Initiating bunker gate drive mechanism. Please wait."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Unregistered residents detected. Initiating standard safety inspection protocol...
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Scan complete. Multiple dangerous items detected. For the safety of other residents, please place all weapons and dangerous items into the designated receptacles.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? It wants us to hand over our weapons!?
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> I apologize for any inconvenience. The purpose of confiscating dangerous items is to ensure the absolute safety of the bunker's residents. Your items will be safely stored. You can retrieve your belongings when you leave.
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> If you have any safety concerns, please rest assured, the bunker is equipped with the most advanced Apocalypse Purification System available. You will encounter no danger here.
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> In the name of Professor (...), I guarantee that no matter what monsters rage beyond the sky's veil, they will not infiltrate our Elysium.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Uhm, beyond the sky's veil? Aren't we at the bottom of the sea?
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, Paimon gets it! It's like those novels in Nasha Town — the "apocalypse" is talking about aliens coming to invade Teyvat...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: You should really stop reading those trashy pulp fiction novels!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Well... that doesn't sound entirely impossible...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: So that's what's going on. Maybe Skirk knows more...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon was only joking! Even if there were invaders from beyond the sky, they wouldn't invade a place like this... Uhm, would they?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Besides, since it's a safe bunker, it seems reasonable to take our weapons off for now, right? Unless they're secretly doing bad things in here...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Like deliberately providing really yucky food... or occasionally breaking the water purifier on purpose... or... locking the main entrance and trapping everyone inside forever...
<color=#ffffff>Ancient Terminal:</color> Please be assured. This bunker is designed to provide absolute safety. All residents are free to leave at any time they wish.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Well, since the mysterious mechanism says it's all above board... Paimon thinks we should trust it, right, Traveler?
<color=#ffffff>Ancient Terminal:</color> Thank you for your cooperation. All dangerous items have been collected. Scan complete. No threats detected. Standard safety inspection protocol complete.
<color=#ffffff>Ancient Terminal:</color> Welcome to the bunker at the end of the apocalypse.
Quest Objective: Explore up ahead
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa! Paimon almost had a heart attack! Why did that alarm go off the second we walked in!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Traveler, why don't we take a closer look at that terminal? We might be able to find something useful!
Quest Objective: Examine the terminal
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Access granted. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Let me see... This looks like a map of the bunker...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But the key card we got last time seems to only give us access to Research Zone 1...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: (Check on the status of Research Zone 1.)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Generating status report. Please wait.
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Research Zone 1: Warning. High concentrations of Abyssal contamination detected. Current risk of overflow: Extreme.
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Apocalypse Purification System: Blocked. Maintenance personnel have been dispatched.
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Time elapsed since previous maintenance request: Error standard hour(s). Please do not panic, resident. Stay calm and await supervisory instructions.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh! This purification system is completely useless!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Okay, Paimon thinks she understands now — the "apocalypse" is actually Abyssal contamination, right? *sigh* This bunker was built to keep out the Abyss, but the contamination inside ended up being worse than anything out there...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Looks like it failed to keep out the Abyss.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Traveler, we've got to figure out a way to deal with this. Otherwise, the contamination could spill out...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Are you sure there isn't more to this story?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon doesn't know. But if we don't do anything, the Abyssal contamination could spill out... Paimon thinks our only choice is to deal with the problem ourselves.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Let's take a look around Research Zone 1.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alright, let's go!
Quest Objective: Go to the second floor
<color=#ffffff>Navigating to target area...</color>
Quest Objective: Investigate the experiment site
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Eek! A Rifthound! What's something like that doing here!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We don't have any weapons... That purification system had better do its job!
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Blocked. Manual activation required."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Operating at Partial Capacity. Thank you for your service, Senior Technician Kotelnikov."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Please proceed to the secondary purification device and complete the repair process. Keep calm and carry on."</color>
(Try to activate the lift)
(After moving for a bit, the lift abruptly stops and an Ancient Terminal falls down from above)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa! You okay, Traveler? The lift over here's gone kaput. Good thing you're not hurt...
(Investigate the broken valve)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Something's definitely missing here... So how are we supposed to get this thing running again, huh?
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Blocked. Manual valve adjustment required."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Research Zone 1: Abnormal. Quarantine is in place.</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Blocked. Manual valve adjustment required."</color>
Quest Objective: Examine the control terminal
Quest Objective: Enter the experiment site and adjust the valves
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Blocked. Manual activation required."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Warning: Severe Contamination Detected. Maintenance personnel are advised to avoid fatal exposure. Unauthorized death is strictly prohibited."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ahh, Paimon doesn't like this at all... Traveler, keep your guard up!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> If only they didn't take away our weapons... *sigh* No point dwelling on that right now! Let's just be careful and sneak around those monsters.
<color=#ffffff>Destroy the chests to attract monsters</color>
(If caught by a Rifthound)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Uh-oh! We've been found... Be careful, Traveler!
(After adjusting all the valves)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Woohoo! We've finished! How about we head back?
<color=#ffffff>"Warning: Severe Contamination Detected."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Experiment site entering quarantine. Please abandon any heavy objects to ensure timely evacuation."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Experiment site quarantined. Proceed to the terminal to confirm purification protocol."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Operating Normally. Thank you for your service, Senior Technician Kotelnikov."</color>
Quest Objective: Leave the experiment site
Quest Objective: Examine the terminal
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Maintenance complete. Apocalypse Purification System: Operating Normally. Key card unlocked.
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Don't forget to retrieve your key card. Have a wonderful day.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Looking closely, this card seems to be a different color from the one we got earlier.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon doesn't know who left it here, but we should take it. Maybe we can find its owner... Oh, right, there doesn't seem to be anyone else here...
Quest Objective: Return to the main control terminal
(While fighting the Evil Eyes of Blightseep in the hallway)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm, looks like these flowers can hold back Abyssal corruption...
(Return to the main control terminal)
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Maintenance order for Research Zone 1 complete. Expected duration exceeded by: 3,942,176 hour(s). A report of negligent conduct has been issued to the supervisory authority.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> H—How many hours? Whoa, Paimon can only remember the first number. How many others were there after that three?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Access updated: Senior Technician Kotelnikov. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Does this thing think we're the maintenance worker sent to repair the purification system...?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon guesses that means we can access more places now! Let's see... This one appears to be Research Zone 2?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: (Check on the status of Research Zone 2.)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Generating status report. Please wait.
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Research Zone 2: Warning. High concentrations of Abyssal contamination and signs of the "Ultimate Calamity" have been detected.
<color=#ffffff>Bunker Access Terminal Server:</color> Apocalypse Purification System: Damaged. Senior Technician Kotelnikov, please proceed to perform repairs under the protection of a guard escort.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> A guard escort? Paimon doesn't see any guards around here... Wait a second — what did it say has been detected?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: It sounded like some sort of Abyssal monster...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Keep me safe, Guard Captain Paimon.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, Paimon'll keep you safe! ...Is what Guard Captain Paimon would say — if she had a weapon. Unfortunately, you'll have to watch your own back.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But if the "apocalypse" is actually just an Abyssal monster, then it's probably the source of this place's contamination...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> If we can take it down, the Abyssal contamination here should be cleaned up once and for all, right? Traveler, let's head to Research Zone 2!
Quest Objective: Investigate the experiment site
(Enter the experiment site)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Traveler, look over there! Is that a gap?
(Proceed through the gap and jump down)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> These claw marks... they're from a Rifthound, right?
<color=#ffffff>"...Keep calm and carry on..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Let the world outside burn in the Apocalypse. We will endure — silent, safe, and forever out of reach of Abyssal contamination..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yikes! That sure was scary... Traveler, be careful!
<color=#ffffff>"...Do you ever worry that the Apocalypse might leak into the bunker? Such anxiety may be a sign of Abyssal contamination. Please report it immediately..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"...Marvel at the foresight of Professor Rotwang..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"...Even as the Apocalypse has swept over mankind, this beacon of humanity still burns bright..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Apocalypse Purification System: Operating Normally. Plant sample deployment complete."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What? How is this even remotely normal!? And whatever was just "deployed" — Paimon doesn't think "plant" is the right word!
Quest Objective: Defeat the monsters
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait — are these pipes carrying kuuvahki? What if we lured it over and made it smash them open...
<color=#ffffff>Lure the Rifthound into attacking the cracked pipes on the ground to damage it</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh! Traveler, what if we break those pipes up there and let the kuuvahki out? That might be enough to beat it!
<color=#ffffff>Break the pipes to release kuuvahki and repel the Rifthound</color>
Quest Objective: Examine the terminal
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Maintenance complete. Apocalypse Purification System: Operating Normally. Key card unlocked.
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Don't forget to retrieve your key card. Have a wonderful day.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh, this time, the key card's golden...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> That terminal report before mentioned signs of large monster activity in Research Zone 2... There's no way it could be talking about the one we just saw, surely?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh, Paimon doesn't get it. For now, let's head back to the terminal and see what this card unlocks.
Quest Objective: Return to the main control terminal
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wh—whoa... the world outside's just gone. The Abyss gobbled it all up...
(Return to the main control terminal)
<color=#ffffff>Automated Bunker Threat Response System:</color> Access updated: Senior Researcher Grazina. Welcome to the Bunker Access Terminal Server.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! It looks like that key card we just picked up still works!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Which makes Paimon think, this Grazina person must have been a pretty big deal — they seem to have had access to the entire bunker...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm, it looks like the only place we haven't been to yet is the Supervisory Office.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> If that "apocalypse" thing is still hanging around, this is the only place it could be. Hmm, Paimon thinks that whatever it is, it's probably not that scary, since scary things wouldn't want to hide from us!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: We'd better keep our eyes peeled — never underestimate an enemy.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Everything should want to hide from us!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah, we're experienced adventurers after all! Even without weapons, Traveler can take down any monster with just a bish — bash — bosh!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alright, let's go check out the Supervisory Office!
Quest Objective: Go to the third floor
<color=#ffffff>Navigating to target area...</color>
Quest Objective: Investigate the nearby area
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Grazina...? You backstabbing snake, how dare you show yourself before me...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa, Traveler, watch out! That monster seems to have been lured out!
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> No, no, you're not Grazina... I can't detect your scent. What are you? A living being, or another spirit flying aimlessly across the bedeviled sky?
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> No living creature can enter this grave... Their grave, our grave. Answer me! Did Professor Rotwang send you here? Has my master forgiven me?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Are you the "apocalypse"?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Apocalypse? Apocalypse! Heh... Haha... Look at the world out there! The apocalypse has already descended upon us!
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Young Solovei tried to stop it, and Brahe, who impersonated Reed Miller. Even that treacherous snake, Grazina — she tried to stop it, too... But their efforts were all in vain. It came... It still came!
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> My master... Professor Rotwang... reduced that pathetic world to ashes with the "SAMPO." After all that destruction, this bunker is all that remains, isolated amid the bedeviled sky...
<color=#ffffff>1.1 Traveler:</color> You think the world has been destroyed?
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> The world outside is nothing but a casket for things beyond their time... I know not from whence you came, but I have already broken free of the celestial shell, no longer to suffer the shackles of gravity and fate!
<color=#ffffff>1.2 Traveler:</color> The world outside's doing pretty well.
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> And you? You are no servant of my master, yet neither are you just another fool... Will you join us — become one with our flesh and our blood — or will you welcome death right here?
<color=#ffffff>The "Ultimate Calamity"?:</color> Join...
<color=#ffffff>Gentle Female Voice:</color> Or die?
<color=#ffffff>1.1.1 Traveler:</color> The world hasn't been destroyed. You're at the bottom of the sea.
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Enough! Cease your vicious lies, vile desecrater! My master would not deceive me — we exist amid the bedeviled sky!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I've had enough of your nonsense. Feel the blade of my sword!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Exactly! Paimon has no idea what you're babbling about... Wait! "Feel the blade of my sword"? You mean the one that's still stored at the entrance!?
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> No matter... No matter! Ignorant fools — even if that snake Grazina has imprisoned me here, your flesh and blood will still become tomorrow's sustenance...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Rotwang is dead, and you're next.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Heh... Haha... I thought I was the only one who could deceive those fools with such crude lies. I didn't expect you to use my own tricks against me...
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Don't think you can fool me! Don't think you can fool us! Professor Rotwang can never die. No... Never! Otherwise, how could Teyvat have been destroyed, and how could we be drifting amid the bedeviled sky?
<color=#ffffff>3.1 Traveler:</color> Teyvat hasn't been destroyed. You're at the bottom of the sea.
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Enough! Cease your vicious lies, vile desecrater! My master would not deceive me — I have already broken free of the celestial shell, no longer to suffer the shackles of gravity and fate!
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate Calamity:</color> Let them be interred in the ruins of that extinguished world. Only we shall continue our existence amid the bedeviled sky — Master, bear witness!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh, there's no other way. Traveler, let's try using these plants to deal with it!
Quest Objective: Defeat the monsters
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh, looks like it's broken... Better figure out how to fix it!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? Traveler, check that out. Do those Spireblooms over there look different to you?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew... That's that dealt with. What an annoying little...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It seemed convinced Teyvat was destroyed, and we were outside the sky...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh! Let's just forget about that idiot! Right, it looks like we've dealt with that thing — whether it was an apocalypse or just the Abyss!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: All thanks to the Mandragoras.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah, and we'd better give credit to that researcher named Grazina, right? Paimon wonders what happened to her...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: All thanks to my sword.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What? You weren't even using your sword! Oh, that reminds Paimon — we can't forget to pick up our stuff before we leave the bunker...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alright, that just about wraps everything— Huh? Wait! What's this?
<color=#ffffff>"To Miss Grazina: Should you ever wish to leave this place, please give this item to a member of the Treasure Hoarders. They will guide you to me." — Master Thief Reed Miller</color>
<color=#ece5d8>(If the player has completed any of the other quests in East of the Moon, West of the Sun)‍</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> P—Proof of the Cognoscenti!? What's that doing in a place like this...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> And it looks like it was left by Reed Miller himself... This means we're one step closer to the Great Treasure!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hehe, Paimon can't wait to find out what it is!
<color=#ece5d8>(If the player has not completed any of the other quests in East of the Moon, West of the Sun)‍</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm... Paimon doesn't get it. So this thing is the "Proof of the Cognoscenti"?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It's a little rusty, but it still looks like a super expensive antique... Could this thing hold some special meaning for the Treasure Hoarders?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Traveler, we'd better take it with us! Paimon has a feeling it's gonna come in handy!
Quest Objective: Examine the terminal
Quest Objective: Leave the bunker
<color=#ffffff>You retrieve your weapon from the mechanism at the entrance, and leave the bunker together with Paimon...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ah...! Paimon can finally breathe fresh air! It was so stuffy in there!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> After all that, there never was an "apocalypse" to begin with! Everything out here is fine and dandy — and there's still plenty of delicious food waiting for us to eat!
